summary: Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery was dispatched for a person extract on Miller Rock after a party spent the night in their vehicle, stuck while trying to assist another stuck party; on scene the team converted the extract to a vehicle recovery (15-minute job pulling the first vehicle sideways and back down the hill) and returned Saturday May 8 to winch the second vehicle back onto the trail, transfer gasoline, and drive it out under its own power.
notes: Parent scope call: dispatched as a person extract for an overnight stranding (multi-day operation, May 6 + May 8 return) — in scope per the overnight-stranded-motorist precedents ids 3470/2425/2467/2490; the on-scene conversion to vehicle recovery is flagged here, not hidden. Party size unstated; victims=1 per the id 2425 convention. Miller Rock near Lyons (Roosevelt National Forest) per AllTrails + Boulder Ranger District corroboration cited by the mining subagent; parent-opened the report live + weekday-verified (Thursday May 6 / Saturday May 8).
